apis.description: The caller's Outlook mail and calendar, read through Microsoft Graph v1.0 with the caller's own access token. The declaration carries no credential: the Authorization header is the ${OUTLOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN} placeholder, expanded from the environment when the declaration is loaded, so the token itself is never written into a file. Only GET operations are declared, so the read-only default method set applies — messages, mail folders, events and the caller's profile; no send, edit or delete endpoint is declared.
apis.name: outlook
